question: In triangle ABC, medians AD, BE, and CF intersect at the Centroid G. If the area of triangle ABC is 60 cm², what is the area of triangle GBC?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The centroid (G) of any triangle connects to its three vertices to form three smaller triangles of equal area.

These three triangles are ΔGAB, ΔGBC, and ΔGCA.

Area of ΔGBC = 1/3 × Area of ΔABC

Area of ΔGBC = 1/3 × 60 = 20 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 60 cm²

⇒ AD, BE, and CF are the medians intersecting at the centroid G.
